While memory costs are expected to be the most expensive component in the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the situation for the iPhone Duo may be different. Here's what we know.

Apple Signs Three-Year Exclusive Display Deal With Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital claimed on Weibo today that Apple has signed a three-year exclusive supply deal with Samsung Display for foldable panels.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and later models," with each panel costing around $250.

The leaker also noted that the panel is "one of the most expensive core components in the entire device," which is hardly surprising.

While there aren't yet reliable reports detailing the expected bill of materials for the iPhone Duo, Apple has shared some interesting information about the materials used in the device—including how much of it is recycled—through its breakdown of the display, camera, processor, memory, and other components.
